description: The bar chart titled “Factual Errors” compares the number of factual errors made by three different question-answering systems — NoR QA (gold bars with diagonal stripes), OneR QA (red bars with white dots), and IRCOT QA (blue bars with diagonal stripes) — across four benchmark datasets: HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC. The vertical y-axis represents the count of factual errors, ranging from 0 to 35 in increments of 5. For HotpotQA, NoR QA incurred 15 errors, OneR QA 10, and IRCOT QA 5. On 2WikiMQA, NoR QA had 29 errors, OneR QA 23, and IRCOT QA 14. For MuSiQue, NoR QA recorded 28 errors, OneR QA 27, and IRCOT QA 23. On IIRC, NoR QA had 15 errors, OneR QA 14, and IRCOT QA 11. Across all datasets, IRCOT QA consistently produced the fewest factual errors, followed by OneR QA, and then NoR QA, which generally had the highest error counts. The bars are grouped by dataset along the horizontal axis, with each group containing three bars corresponding to the three systems, and the values are explicitly labeled atop each bar.
